external_trust_boundary.authority_limit: The cooperating executor obeys the owner-authorized research scope and exact released instruction. SHA binding is not hostile-host authentication or a cryptographic human approval system. A random caller hash/flag/copied receipt is not an authorized execution.
external_trust_boundary.expected_release_sha_origin: Exact independently reviewed manifest SHA in the specific lead execution instruction, supplied separately from runtime/data files. It is not read from its own contents or derived from caller metadata.
external_trust_boundary.scope: Reviewed local source research under existing owner request; no extra blanket owner permission, spend/credentials/account/publication approval or daemon required.

limits.limit_semantics: Future ceilings, not measured source/render sizes; oversized inputs refuse and require a separate reviewed amendment. No rendering or OCR is proposed for this stage.

literal_rules.hash_meaning: SHA256 of transcribed UTF8 display bytes, not original imagePDF character encoding.
literal_rules.normalization: Only trim/collapse whitespace for identity; retain literal bytes. Punctuation/accents/case/office disagreement blocks.

no_cycle_rule: Only stable source-policy digest is compiled into admission code. Runtime/data/audit/release hashes are bound by the externally pinned release manifest, never compiled back into the module it hashes. The outer manifest binds runtime and all grant documents; grant documents must not hash that outer manifest or a future runtime that already references them.
